read_limits.voice: Voice, VoiceViseme and SpeechAmount() are native non-reflected members; their actual values cannot be read through the Python wrapper. Speech morph weights are recorded separately, never substituted for the voice envelope.
read_limits.derived_alpha: EmoteAlpha(), BodyAlpha() and PainAlpha() are native non-reflected getters. The labelled derived values use only reflected state, library entries, animation length and the checked current source formula in this standalone world.
read_limits.grip_targets: GetRowingHandTargets() is native non-reflected. Expected right wrist is reconstructed from the actual brush world transform and the character Brush/BrushPivot relative attachment transforms. The labelled left target is 20 cm along the actual brush X axis, matching the checked source; it is not a native getter result.
read_limits.morph_weights: USkeletalMeshComponent.GetMorphTarget() reads the current MorphTargetCurves map, returning zero when no curve is present. This does not prove that a zero-valued morph asset exists or has zero final GPU deformation.
